name: m_tgamma
reason: GammaDoc pins only the special values, the table for 1..23, OverflowError above 200 and when ValueError is raised, so a m_tgamma returning 0.0 for every other finite non-integer (the 1/x branch below 1e-20, which needs no libm, the 0/m_sinpi branch below -200 and the Lanczos branch) passes.

name: m_lgamma
reason: GammaDoc pins only nan, +-inf, lgamma(1), lgamma(2) and the poles, so the value for every other finite x (-log(absx) below 1e-20, the Lanczos sum and the reflection) is unconstrained; returning 0.0 there passes.

name: m_remainder
reason: Its only entry, mathint-remainder-exact, is open (the Sterbenz argument is missing).

name: m_log
reason: LogTwins (LogFacts) pins NaN, +inf, ValueError for zeros, negatives and -inf, and the C log's value on positive finite floats, for every sane C log.

name: m_log2
reason: LogTwins pins the special values and the C log2's value; Log2PowersOfTwo adds exactness on powers of two.

name: m_log10
reason: LogTwins pins the special values and the C log10's value on positive finite floats.

name: is_error
reason: Math1Rules, Math1aRules and Math2Rules state only errno 0, EDOM and ERANGE, so the third branch (any other errno raises PyErr_SetFromErrno(ValueError), :751-753) is never constrained: an is_error that returns 0 for it passes.

name: math_1
reason: Math1Rules, for every C function, flag and argument: conversion errors, NaN and infinity rules with the formatted domain message, EDOM, ERANGE below and above 1.5, and the plain result (the unexpected-errno case is is_error's gap).

name: math_1a
reason: Math1aRules: conversion errors, errno 0, EDOM with and without err_msg (the formatted message), and ERANGE below and above 1.5, for every C function.

name: math_2
reason: Math2Rules: the arity TypeError, conversion errors in argument order, and every NaN, infinity and errno rule, for every two-argument C function.

name: math_ceil
reason: FloorCeilTrunc: exact ceiling (NaN and inf errors) for floats and non-overriding subclasses, an overriding __ceil__'s result or exception, ints and bools exact, and the __float__/__index__ fallback with its errors.

name: math_floor
reason: FloorCeilTrunc pins the same cases for floor: exact float floor, overrides, ints, bools, and the conversion fallback with its errors.

name: math_signbit_impl
reason: MathClassify: conversion errors and signbit(x) == (copysign(1.0, x) < 0) for every argument object.

name: _fsum_realloc
reason: Its only entry, mathint-fsum-correctly-rounded, is open.

name: math_fsum
reason: Its only entry, mathint-fsum-correctly-rounded, is open (the Shewchuk invariant and the half-even correction are not proven); the special-value, -inf + inf and iteration-error paths have no statement either.

name: math_trunc

name: math_frexp_impl
reason: FrexpLdexp: conversion error, 0.5 <= abs(m) < 1 and m * 2**e == x exactly for finite nonzero x, (x, 0) otherwise, and ldexp(*frexp(x)) == x.

name: math_ldexp_impl
reason: FrexpLdexp: x conversion first, the TypeError for a non-int, and for every int however large x * 2**i rounded once (ldexpSpec), which pins the LONG_MAX/LONG_MIN replacement and the INT_MAX/INT_MIN guards.

name: math_modf_impl
reason: ModfDoc: conversion error, (nan, nan), (+-0.0, +-inf), and for finite x the truncated integer part and the exact fraction, both with the sign of x.

name: loghelper_int

name: loghelper
reason: LogFacts covers only ints, exact floats and objects with __index__ and no __float__ (whose __index__ is assumed to return the same int both times it is called), so objects with __float__, the OverflowError retry for such an object that also has __index__, and the TypeError for non-numbers are unconstrained.

name: math_log

name: math_log2
reason: The body is loghelper(x, m_log2); LogTwins and Log2PowersOfTwo pin its special values, the C log2's value, the int/float agreement and exact powers of two (loghelper's own gaps are recorded on that row).

name: math_log10
reason: The body is loghelper(x, m_log10); LogTwins pins its special values, the C log10's value and the int/float agreement (loghelper's own gaps are recorded on that row).

name: math_fma_impl
reason: FmaDoc: conversion errors in order, the exactly rounded value with the zero sign and OverflowError, NaN propagation, the invalid-operation ValueError and the signed infinity, for every argument.

name: math_fmod_impl
reason: FmodDoc: conversion errors in order, fmod(x, +-inf) == x, NaN, the domain ValueError, and for finite operands the unique truncated remainder (x - n*y, abs < abs(y), sign of x).

name: math_dist_impl
reason: HypotDist covers only exact-float coordinates, so the ASSIGN_DOUBLE conversion of each px and qx (ints, objects with __float__ or __index__, and the error on the first item that fails) is never constrained.

name: math_hypot_impl
reason: HypotDist covers only exact-float coordinates (conversion failures are unstated) and pins the value only for zero or one coordinate and for inf/NaN, so for two or more finite coordinates a version passing a wrong max to vector_norm passes; even the docstring's hypot(3.0, 4.0) == 5.0 is not stated.

name: math_pow_impl
reason: PowTwin compares every special-value and errno branch with float_pow for every C pow satisfying the stated Annex F assumptions (reasonable: glibc meets them); the clinic conversion is outside this impl.

name: math_isfinite_impl
reason: MathClassify: conversion errors and isfinite(x) == (x == x and x not +-inf) for every argument object.

name: math_isnormal_impl
reason: MathClassify: finite, nonzero and abs(x) >= 2**-1022, stated on the exact value rather than the bit fields the model uses.

name: math_issubnormal_impl

name: math_isnan_impl
reason: MathClassify: conversion errors and isnan(x) == (x != x).

name: math_isinf_impl
reason: MathClassify: conversion errors and isinf(x) == (x in (inf, -inf)).

name: math_isclose_impl

name: math_prod_impl

name: math_ulp_impl
